users.title: Users
users.cannotDeleteSelf: You cannot delete your own account
users.inviteCreated: Invite created for {{email}} ({{role}}). Share this link so they can register — it expires {{expires}}.

access.title: Connection access
access.description: Grant a user access to connections they don't own. Granted users can ask questions, run read-only queries, browse the schema, and edit the glossary — but cannot change or delete the connection.
access.adminHasAccess: {{email}} is an admin and already has access to every connection. There is nothing to grant.
access.noConnectionsYet: There are no connections to share yet.
access.confirmDiscard: You have unsaved changes. Discard them?

usage.title: Token usage
usage.description: LLM token usage across all users. Captured on every provider call (SQL generation, result summaries, and suggested questions).
usage.empty: No token usage recorded for this period yet.

audit.title: Audit log
audit.description: Every user's questions and generated SQL. Result rows are never stored.

clarity.description: Every day at the configured time, the panel fetches the previous day’s Clarity data. Clarity allows only {{budget}} API requests per day; each dimension combination below costs one request.
clarity.tokenSetPlaceholder: Token is set — enter a new one to replace it
clarity.tokenPlaceholder: Paste your Clarity Data Export token
clarity.combosDescription: Each row is one API request fetching yesterday’s metrics broken down by up to 3 dimensions. An empty row fetches overall totals.

prompts.title: AI prompts
prompts.description: These system prompts steer the AI in the Ask and Analysis sections. Changes apply immediately to new requests.
prompts.confirmReset: Reset "{{title}}" to the built-in default prompt?

askSettings.title: Ask analysis mode
askSettings.intro: When enabled, every Ask question runs a deeper investigation: the AI scans the table list, requests details for the tables it needs, and runs small read-only exploratory queries to understand the data before writing the final SQL. Users watch each step live.
askSettings.warning: ⚠ Exploratory queries send a small sample of row data (capped below) to the AI provider — an exception to the schema-only default that applies only while this mode is on.
askSettings.enable: Enable Ask analysis mode for all users
